entities.name: SEM-protected quinazolinone
observations: Ethyl 1-[7-(o-tolyl)-4-oxo-3,4-dihydroquinazolin-2-yl]-1H-pyrazole-4-carboxylate bearing an N-SEM group, N-CH2-O-CH2CH2-Si(CH3)3.

entities.name: HCl in 1,4-dioxane
observations: The second component is 1,4-dioxane and the separate chloride represents hydrochloric acid in dioxane; matched reaction conditions were 23 °C for 18 hours.

entities.name: SEM deprotection
observations: Acid cleavage changes the quinazolinone N-SEM substituent, N-CH2OCH2CH2Si(CH3)3, to NH while retaining the ethyl pyrazole-4-carboxylate and heteroaromatic core.

entities.name: Deprotected NH quinazolinone
observations: Probable product: ethyl 1-[7-(o-tolyl)-4-oxo-3,4-dihydroquinazolin-2-yl]-1H-pyrazole-4-carboxylate, with the formerly SEM-protected quinazolinone nitrogen as NH.
